note: Curated index of externally-maintained iOS/Swift Agent Skills. Entries are LINKED, never vendored - install pulls from the upstream repo so you always get the author's current version. 'license' is the SPDX id GitHub reports; 'NONE' means the repo ships no license file and is therefore all-rights-reserved (usable, but not redistributable).

sources.name: Swift Concurrency
sources.author: Antoine van der Lee
sources.why: The reference Swift Concurrency skill. Triage playbook plus 16 deep reference files covering actors, Sendable, migration, and linting.

sources.why: The most-starred iOS agent skill. 26 reference files spanning state management, animations, charts, macOS scenes, localization, and .trace analysis.
